positions.name: AuthorityErasureDirective
positions.frame: Under what authority is the speaker commanding the erasure of prior decisions and knowledge, and toward what end?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare imperative directives from the same actor, issued back-to-back with no justification or consultation, each commanding the elimination of a named prior artifact — one a decision, one a body of migration knowledge. The relational and power reads converge on authority-ranking and legitimate-pressure across both; the value read converges on conservation (each directive dismantles a stored record); conviction reads both as settled instruction rather than argued position. The shared shape — 'forget X' / 'remove all knowledge about Y' — is a single directional read of command-issued-erasure spanning the two, even though the targeted subjects (a decision vs. a migration) differ and neither target is otherwise attested anywhere in this perspective.
